execution.notes: Phase 2 (Shared, 5 tasks) and Phase 3 (Feature, 8 tasks) complete with zero errors and zero warnings under `SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS = YES`. Build passes on iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 18.3.1) simulator for scheme `calo-ai-test`, Debug configuration. All 32 acceptance criteria in `requirements.md` are covered by at least one done task — see updated Traceability Matrix in `tasks.md`. The Supabase Swift SDK / Firebase / RevenueCat SPM packages are intentionally deferred (project-structure 2.3.1); the `SupabaseRESTClient` uses `URLSession` against PostgREST/GoTrue endpoints over HTTPS, with the same surface that a future SPM-backed implementation would expose, so the swap is an internal detail behind the `DataClienting` protocol. Also shipped `Shared/Utils/MockData.swift` (4 demo users, 30+ ingredient templates, 25 meal templates generating 14-day realistic meal history), `App/MockEnvironmentFactory.swift` (auto-seeds in-memory services), and updated `CaloApp.init()` to use the factory in DEBUG builds so the app launches with populated Camera / Diary / Dashboard / Settings / Paywall without a backend (set `CALO_DISABLE_MOCKS=1` in env to use the live services).
